title: Document shows Pandolfi supplying gravitational-wave briefers for the Jasons

tellings.quote: there, but there's a a document was found about uh gravitational waves where he was finding the speakers. There's it shows Ron Bendalf's providing this the the briefers.

plain: A researcher, Grant Cameron, talks about a man named Ron Pandolfi and the Jasons, a group of top scientists who advise the US government. Cameron says a document about gravitational waves, tiny ripples in space itself, was found, and that it shows Pandolfi finding and supplying the experts who briefed the group. If true, it would put Pandolfi at the center of quiet high-level science work.
